newsitem.title: UK: BOE invites fixed rate repo at unchanged 6.0%.
newsitem.headline: BOE invites fixed rate repo at unchanged 6.0%.

text.p: The Bank of England invited a fixed rate round of operations to offset the estimated money market shortage of 750 million stg and said the repo rate was unchanged at 6.0 percent.

Analysts said this implied that Chancellor of the Exchequer Kenneth Clarke had decided not to raise interest rates following Thursday afternoon's monthly monetary meeting with Bank of England Governor Eddie George.
This is the first round of money market operations since the meeting.
The operations will comprise repos to April 28 and outright offers of bills maturing on or before April 28.
